q: Walk me through September: how much did we sell, what did it cost us to get those sales, and what was left at the end?
answer:
By order date: September net sales were ₹15,74,765. The business made ₹9,07,026 of contribution (net sales − COGS ₹6,67,739) but ad delivery costs (delivery-date / P&L ad spend) were ₹11,93,322, leaving a negative contribution-after-ads (net profit) of −₹2,86,296 — ads cost more than the margin they bought.

What that means
- Top‑line: Net sales (order date) = ₹15,74,765 for 01–30 Sep 2026.  
- Cost of goods: Net COGS (order date) = ₹6,67,739, so contribution before ads = ₹9,07,026.  
- Cost to get sales: Ad spend (delivery / P&L basis) = ₹11,93,322 — this is measured on delivery date (finance/paid_media clock).  
- Left at the end: Contribution after ads / net profit (order-date basis) = −₹2,86,296 (contribution minus P&L ad spend). This shows ad delivery exceeded the margin available to cover it.

Worth checking: ad efficiency by platform/campaign (ad spend ÷ contribution) and whether ad spend timing or allocation (delivery-date vs order-date) is inflating reported ad costs.

Period: 2026-09-01..2026-09-30 · Currency: INR · Data as of 2026-10-29
